visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of campaign cards: key visual + campaign name + 'View campaign' link
notes: 1 column mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop; key visual in a fixed 4:3 frame (object-fit cover).
Empty image cell renders a brand-navy placeholder panel showing the campaign name.
Whole card is clickable via the single CTA link (stretched link).

contentPattern.structure: one row per campaign; cell 1 = key visual image (may be empty), cell 2 = richtext (h3 campaign name + p>a 'View campaign →')

usage: Home page campaign overview listing current campaigns with a link to each campaign page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-led list of linked items (campaigns, programmes) where each card has one onward link.

blockStructure.notes: One row per card; empty image cell must still be included.
